halloween-nighttrail|2026-10-24.summary: Halloween Nighttrail in Lichtaart, with separate 4 km, 8 km and 14 km trail runs after dark.

4K.note: Official organiser programme: the 4 km trail run starts at 19:05. The family walk starts separately at 19:15.
4K.publicNote: 4 km trail run starts at 19:05 local time.

8K.note: Official organiser programme: the 8 km trail run starts at 18:55. The walk starts separately at 19:15.
8K.publicNote: 8 km trail run starts at 18:55 local time.

14K.note: Official organiser programme: the 14 km trail run starts at 18:30. The walk starts separately at 18:40.
14K.publicNote: 14 km trail run starts at 18:30 local time.
